Hi Alex —

Great to meet yesterday. As discussed, I'm sharing a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template and a starter slides deck to help align stakeholders and define the evaluation milestones. I dropped a copy here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-example-MapTemplate (edit access sent to you). Attachments: BriteBox_MAP_Template_v3.gdoc, Kickoff_Slides_v1.gslides.

Suggested first pass:
- Week 0 (this week): stakeholder alignment + access checklist (owner: BriteBox procurement).
- Week 1–2: pilot integration + model validation (owner: BriteBox eng / Redwood infra support).
- Week 3: acceptance tests + cost/latency review (acceptance criteria in template).

Two asks for us to keep momentum:
1) Can you add your procurement contact and confirm data access timelines in the doc by Friday 9/17?
2) Would you be available for a 30-min draft session this Thursday or Friday to co-edit the MAP and review the acceptance matrix? (I linked my calendar below)

I'll preload the doc with the Redwood-side milestones and a simple acceptance matrix (we can refine together). If helpful, Ben will join the draft session to capture deployment/ops items and Tessa will add the success metrics slide.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a pragmatic path to POC.

Best,
Laura Bennett
